statement: Every nonzero binary apartment-code support induces degree 4(q-1) inside the intrinsic 8(q-1)-regular theta point graph and degree 4(q-1) to its complement.
distance_reformulation: A sufficient all-q graph theorem is: no nonempty theta-even induced half-regular support has fewer than q^4 vertices.
boundary: Half-regularity alone is not asserted sufficient for theta parity.
